contract: Local bounded volatile attempt/deadline runner over pure retry policy; default forbids possibly-dispatched retries; validates and correlates completed results; dead-letter sink failures settle as unsettled.
limits: Local single-node volatile operations; no durability, exactly-once, at-least-once, distributed credit or shedding.
Capacity bounds admitted operations (including backoff), not OTP mailbox bytes. Caller call timeout means unknown admission.
Completed means validated Adapter report, not durable Effect evidence. Sink :ok is not locally proven durable.
Runner restart loses operations without settlement; monitor DOWN as unknown. Tasks and Effects may outlive runner.
Blocking sink blocks the runner; raises, throws, exits and non-ok returns yield unsettled. No operational drain or telemetry supplied.

Attempts run with :brutal_kill shutdown; the runner removes each attempt child through Task.Supervisor.terminate_child/2 before retry, resubmission or settlement, so trap_exit cannot cause the default 5000 ms wait. The removal call is bounded by the supervisor queue, so the Task.Supervisor should be dedicated or hold only :brutal_kill children. Task cleanup code does not run and an external Effect may persist.
Helper laws do not prove the runner, integer comparisons, classification or conservation; those have finite test/model evidence.
RedispatchIdempotent is a caller assertion, not a checked provider guarantee.
